rationale: NIST AI RMF 1.0 MAP outcomes address intended context and knowledge limits; MEASURE addresses TEVV considerations and uncertainty/performance measures; MANAGE outcomes address superseding, disengaging or deactivating systems as part of response and recovery. The claim accurately describes lifecycle-oriented calls for documentation without converting them into a sector safety criterion.
evidence_locators: S-EVID-001-R2 — PDF p. 28, MEASURE introductory text
S-EVID-001-R3 — PDF pp. 31–32, MANAGE 2 and 4 outcomes
limitations: AI RMF 1.0 is voluntary horizontal guidance and is under revision according to the source record.
It does not establish transportation certification, an acceptable risk level, or approval of a system.
